# Vendored IFEval evaluator

The `instruction_following_eval` directory is copied without functional changes from
`google-research/google-research` commit `932d4685e23f671b9e8c2abc72dd228ba5ff9252`.
It is used for the official strict and loose IFEval checks. The upstream Apache-2.0
license is preserved in `third_party/google_research/LICENSE`.
